title: Banquet Hall for Sale in Indore, India
tagline: The business operates an established hospitality and event venue in Indore. - It generates annual revenue of ₹35-40 million INR (₹3.5-4 Crore INR) per year through venue bookings, accommodation, and event-related services. - Business benefits from demand for weddings, family celebrations, and social functions. - The venue has two marriage gardens and receives 25 bookings per garden during peak months. - It employs 30 staff members to support venue operations and event management. - The business offers a combination of outdoor event spaces, guest accommodation, and banquet facilities. The property spans 80,000 sq. ft. and is registered under a single ownership. - The business has a GST certificate and MSME certificate.
